title: Singapore Romantic Escape | Night Safari, Skyline Views & Sentosa Experiences
highlights: This 5-day Singapore couple itinerary combines iconic attractions, romantic experiences, and seamless city exploration in one well-planned holiday.
Stay in a centrally located hotel at an unexpected rate offering comfortable rooms and easy access to Singapore’s top attractions, ensuring a relaxed stay for couples.
Enjoy a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, featuring thrilling rides, immersive zones, and entertainment designed for shared experiences.
Discover Sentosa Island with curated experiences including cable car rides, a visit to the Singapore Oceanarium, and the Wings of Time show, ideal for couple getaway.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the highlights of Singapore on a perfectly curated journey blending iconic sights, thrilling attractions, and immersive experiences. Begin with an enchanting evening at the world-renowned Night Safari Singapore, where a guided tram ride takes you through natural habitats of fascinating nocturnal wildlife. Discover the city’s landmarks, including Merlion Park, followed by panoramic skyline views from Marina Bay Sands SkyPark. Continue to Gardens by the Bay and explore the mist-filled Cloud Forest, the vibrant Flower Dome, and the immersive Jurassic World Experience. Enjoy cinematic thrills at Universal Studios Singapore with world-class rides and themed zones. Head to Sentosa Island for scenic views aboard the Singapore Cable Car and interactive fun at Singapore Oceanarium, and conclude with the spectacular Wings of Time. Depart with unforgettable memories of Singapore’s skyline, attractions, and vibrant island charm.

know_before_you_go: Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
The activities and tickets included in the package are non-refundable in case of cancellation.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance while visiting Singapore. Travel insurance is not a part of the package.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Singapore’s climate is commonly tropical and humid. It is advisable to carry light, comfortable clothes.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While Singapore widely accepts credit card payments, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. PAN Card will not be considered valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Images are for representation purposes only.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Night Safari Experience
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon landing at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, relax for a while. Later, get driven to visit the world's first nocturnal wildlife park at the Singapore Night Safari. Once there, Wander through diverse habitats and encounter over 2,500 animals, from leopards and tigers to exotic nocturnal species, experiencing the thrill of wildlife after dark in immersive, naturalistic settings. Also, ride the tram through different habitats.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Marina Bay Sands Sky Park  & Gardens by the Bay
days.desc: Today, embark on a Singapore city tour, visiting the bustling streets of Chinatown, where culture, history, and colorful markets come alive. Capture iconic photos at Marina Bay’s Merlion Park and marvel at the architecture of the DNA-shaped Helix Bridge. Also, enjoy panoramic city views from the Singapore Flyer. Later, ascend to the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for stunning views of the skyline and visit the Gardens by the Bay, wandering through the misty Cloud Forest and the famous flower dome.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer & get driven to Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s only Hollywood-themed park. Once there, explore seven immersive zones, from Ancient Egypt to Sci-Fi City, each packed with unique experiences. Also, feel the thrill on blockbuster rides like Battlestar Galactica and Transformers, catch spectacular live shows, meet beloved movie characters, and enjoy family-friendly attractions, combining adrenaline, entertainment, and unforgettable cinematic magic.

days.title: Sentosa Island Day Tour with Singapore Cable Car | Visit to Singapore Oceanarium | Wings of Time
days.desc: Set off for an unforgettable day at Sentosa Island. Board your transfer to Universal Studios Singapore & from there, head to Imbiah Station for a ride on the Singapore Cable Car. Once in Sentosa, you can walk or take a shuttle to the Singapore Oceanarium & explore immersive marine habitats showcasing thousands of aquatic species, from vibrant coral reefs to open ocean ecosystems. In the evening, head to witness the Wings of Time, a spectacular show blending water, laser, and fire effects.
